rationale: All four blocking findings from the final review are resolved. CR-001: archive UPDATE now carries WHERE lifecycle_state=STALE, preventing clobber of a concurrently reactivated row. CR-002: stale_stmt now excludes error=True rows, matching the marking phase. CR-003: the CR-001 lifecycle predicate provides the accepted partial mitigation; the TOCTOU window is documented with a comment and the complete_progress() self-healing path is noted. CR-004: metrics are now collected in pending_metrics during the ES delete loop and emitted only after session.commit() succeeds. No new high-risk issues introduced by the fix-up diff.

business_review.requirement: Deletion runs after marking phase commits when STALE_DATASOURCE_DELETION_ENABLED=True
business_review.notes: Confirmed: _delete_stale_indexes() called after session.commit() in detect_and_mark_stale_datasources().

business_review.requirement: Three-state lifecycle ACTIVE→STALE→ARCHIVED, ES-only deletion, PG row preserved
business_review.notes: sa_update sets lifecycle_state=ARCHIVED; no PG row deleted; GitRepo/integrations untouched.

business_review.requirement: Write ordering: ES delete first (ignore_unavailable=True), PG ARCHIVED second
business_review.notes: asyncio.to_thread ES delete precedes the bulk sa_update + commit.

business_review.requirement: Shared-index guard skips STALE rows whose index is used by an ACTIVE row
business_review.notes: active_index_names set built from all ACTIVE rows; stale row skipped if get_index_identifier() present in set.

business_review.requirement: Circuit breaker aborts if len(candidates) > STALE_DATASOURCE_MAX_DELETIONS_PER_RUN
business_review.notes: Returns deletion_aborted=True before any delete when cap exceeded.

business_review.requirement: Multiple STALE rows on same index: single ES delete, all rows archived
business_review.notes: defaultdict(list) groups rows by index_name; single to_thread call per group; all IDs in rows_to_archive.

business_review.requirement: Per-item ES failure does not stop sweep; failed row stays STALE
business_review.notes: Per-index except block increments deletion_errors and continues; failed rows never added to rows_to_archive.

business_review.requirement: complete_progress() reactivates any lifecycle state to ACTIVE, clears marked_stale_at
business_review.notes: Sets self.lifecycle_state=ACTIVE, self.marked_stale_at=None; passes lifecycle_state=ACTIVE + clear_marked_stale_at=True to update_progress().

business_review.requirement: set_error() does NOT reactivate a STALE/ARCHIVED datasource
business_review.notes: set_error() passes no lifecycle_state to update_progress().
finalize_settings() guard confirmed at config.py lines 875-878.

business_review.requirement: Two new config fields: STALE_DATASOURCE_DELETION_ENABLED (bool=False) + STALE_DATASOURCE_MAX_DELETIONS_PER_RUN (int=100)
business_review.notes: Both fields present with correct defaults.

business_review.requirement: Metric stale_datasource_index_deleted emitted per deleted index with {project, repo_name, datasource_type}
business_review.notes: MetricName enum entry present; send_count_metric called per row with correct attributes after commit.

business_review.requirement: All 8 STALE_DATASOURCE_* env vars added to Helm values with safe defaults

business_review.notes: stale_datasource/config.py: STALE_DATASOURCE_LOCK_ID = 987654326; comment records full registry.

business_review.requirement: In-flight protection: completed=False, is_fetching=True, is_queued=True excluded from deletion
business_review.notes: stale_stmt filters completed==True and is_fetching/is_queued == False or NULL. Now also excludes error=True rows (CR-002 fix).

business_review.requirement: Dead already_stale code removed from detect_and_mark_stale_datasources()
business_review.notes: Key removed from stats dict; tracking block removed from evaluation loop; scheduler log updated.

standards_review.notes: Fix-up commit fix(EPMCDME-13161): address code-review findings CR-001/CR-002/CR-003/CR-004 follows Conventional Commits format with ticket ID.
noqa E712 annotations on ORM boolean comparisons; pending_metrics pattern is idiomatic Python; type hints consistent.
No new security surface. Fix-up diff is purely additive guards and a structural refactor of metric emission.

finding_status.notes: WHERE lifecycle_state == LifecycleState.STALE predicate added to the archive sa_update. UPDATE is now a no-op for any row that transitioned out of STALE between ES deletion and PG commit.
or_(IndexInfo.error == False, IndexInfo.error.is_(None)) added to stale_stmt WHERE clause. Matches error-exclusion logic in _get_candidate_datasources().

Accepted partial mitigation: CR-001 lifecycle predicate prevents clobbering a reactivated ACTIVE row. TOCTOU window documented with a code comment; complete_progress() reactivation self-heals queued-but-STALE rows. Per-candidate re-check not implemented; acknowledged as optional full-protection enhancement.

pending_metrics list collects per-row metric payloads during ES delete loop. AgentMonitoringService.send_count_metric called only after session.commit() succeeds. New test test_metrics_not_emitted_when_commit_fails verifies the invariant.
